description: Frozen snake_case taxonomy for RIE datasets and domain packs (authoritative: Docmentation/OVERVIEW.txt, updated per §8.3.2)

category_intent_guidance.filter_rule: Use include/exclude operations to explicitly state which records to keep or remove (include/exclude).
category_intent_guidance.data_quality_rule: Flag or validate records; actions usually include validation, exclusion, or flagging for manual review (validation/exclude/flag).
category_intent_guidance.metric_definition: Define metrics as compositions over fields; operations typically include, exclude, or subtract values (include/exclude/subtract).
category_intent_guidance.mapping_rule: Map or replace raw status values into canonical business statuses (map/replace).
category_intent_guidance.access_rule: Define permissions or access scope for roles/users (restrict).
category_intent_guidance.join_rule: Define how tables relate or join conditions for derived metrics (map/join).
